summary: Injured male skier aided on South Diamond Peak; stabilized by LCSAR hasty team and evacuated by rescue toboggan to awaiting UCHealth team.
location: South Diamond Peak, bench below Ptarmigan Face
notes: Date approximate: inferred from 2024-05-01 post describing 'last weekend'. Diamond Peaks Ski Patrol evacuated via rescue toboggan; Jackson County SAR, UCHealth LifeLine, Poudre Canyon Fire, CO Parks & Wildlife, USFS also involved.
